description:
Get the runtime schema of a DEPLOYED graph project — shows the actual entity types and relationship types available for data operations.

Returns, by key (the entity_type and rel_type every graph tool takes and every node and relationship answers):
• entities: path, parent and fields; a nested entity holds its ancestors' fields too (each names the entity that declares it, "declared_by"), so a create carries every required one
• relationships: from_type / to_type (the entities it names), from_types / to_types (those and every entity nested under them, which an end also accepts), cardinality and fields

⭐ USE THIS FIRST before creating nodes/relationships to know what entity_type and rel_type values are valid.

FILLING A GRAPH FROM A TEXT:
1. Use the entity and relationship keys exactly as this schema gives them
2. Fill every required field, the inherited ones included
3. Before creating an entity, search for it (fulltext_search_graph) and reuse its entity_id when it exists; before relating nodes that already existed, read the relationships among them (get_graph_subgraph, those nodes as seeds, depth 0) and skip one already there
4. Record only what the text states
5. When the schema has source or page fields, fill them
6. Write the nodes in bulk (bulk_create_graph_nodes, one call per entity), then the relationships (bulk_create_graph_relationships, one call per relationship)
name: get_graph_data_schema
title: Get Graph Data Schema
